content: AI context sharing between people: TeamBrain (shared workspace read by every teammate's AI through a custom connector; markets itself against Team-plan-only project sharing; lifetime deal from USD 49), Contexter (hosted MCP, one project context across ChatGPT/Claude, shareable to a person), BotSesh/AgentCouch (shared MCP rooms), shared Google Docs workaround. These are shared-workspace (pull) models, not person-to-person delivery (push). Vendor pages, single source each.
